public_rationale: KBRA's May 1, 2026 analysis describes RD Michigan Property Owner I LLC's leases as having fixed-date rent commencement and no tenant termination option for late delivery [e1]. Fitch's May 4 analysis independently describes those protections against construction delays [e2]. This is a contractual exception within April–June 2026: customer rent obligations can begin despite delayed completion, contradicting the claim about every AI data center SPV [e1, e2]. PPM America's July 14 discussion describes completion-dependent rent in deals it reviewed, but does not establish a universal rule [e3].
limitations: The evidence consists of rating-agency descriptions; executed leases were not retrieved.
Contractual payment obligations do not establish actual receipt of payments before completion.
PPM America's discussion falls outside the selected April–June 2026 period.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: Every AI data center SPV is funded by customer payments that only arrive if the data center is completed.

statement.excerpt: I also want to be clear about something: every single AI data center SPV is funded by customer payments which will only arrive if the data center actually gets completed.

our_interpretation: The claim concerns contractual dependence of customer payments on completion, not whether third-party debt and equity initially finance construction.
A qualifying counterexample is an AI data-center SPV whose customer owes rent or construction-related payments despite delayed completion or power delivery.
Contractual payment obligations are assessed; actual future payment receipt or customer default is not forecast.
Use April 1 through June 30, 2026, the latest completed calendar quarter publicly reportable before the post, for this undated ongoing observation.
This is a claim about payment conditions, without a monetary amount or accounting measure; metric_scope is therefore null.
criteria.support_condition: Comprehensive financing and customer-contract evidence establishes that every in-scope SPV's customer payments require completion.
criteria.contradiction_condition: At least one in-scope SPV has enforceable customer-payment obligations that can commence despite incomplete delivery, including prepayments, fixed-date rent or qualifying delay payments.
